assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent RGBA sprite animation sheet for a 2D gothic dark fantasy action RPG. ONE sheet with EXACTLY 8 coherent animation frames in a strictly aligned 4 COLUMN x 2 ROW grid. Wide canvas approximately 2048x1024, eight equal square cells. Read order left-to-right top row frames 0,1,2,3 then left-to-right bottom row frames 4,5,6,7. Each frame is a different actual deformation / pose of the SAME effect, not eight identical illustrations. Cell backgrounds fully transparent, no drawn separators or numbers. Every frame completely inside its own cell, generous transparent gutters, never cross cell boundaries. Side view attack points RIGHT. Shared stationary source anchor in every cell at x=15%, y=55%; consistent apparent scale, brightest tip reaches no farther than x=90%. Crisp painted brush details readable at 180px, restrained glow. No character, no floor, no circular aura, no sector, no sigil, no text, no watermark, no checkerboard artwork. Animate a SINGLE blood crimson and near-black living thorn VINE WHIP held at that fixed left grip. ONE flexible vine, tiny thorns, crimson motion wisps attached to the vine. Frame 0: vine drawn back in compact curl above grip. Frame 1: tighter S coil preparing to strike. Frame 2: fully tensioned curl, tip pulled back, strongest anticipation. Frame 3: vine begins uncoiling toward right, half extension. Frame 4: fully extended fast rightward lash, long flowing shallow S and bright tiny tip, THIS is the contact pose. Frame 5: lash bends downward in follow-through, tip moving past hit. Frame 6: vine recoils into smaller curve returning left, thinner red wisps. Frame 7: returned compact coil and very faint trailing sparks, visually quiet. Show real curvature changes of the vine with each frame, fixed grip NEVER moves, no shrub branches, no solid axe, no giant flame.
